Action: Administrator logs in, selects Sunrise Model School, reaches authorized dashboard
Expected_Result: Dashboard visible; institution selected and permissions applied

Action: Administrator creates a role with restricted module access and verifies it
Expected_Result: Permissions enforced; unauthorized module hidden/403

Action: Teacher records attendance for their own class
Expected_Result: Attendance saved and visible only to authorized teacher

Action: Teacher tries entering marks for unassigned subject
Expected_Result: Denied; no unauthorized marks changed

Action: Process admission application to approved enrollment
Expected_Result: Student, admission and enrollment linked without duplicate

Action: Issue fee invoice, record partial/full payment
Expected_Result: Invoice balances and receipt reconcile with GL

Action: Submit a refund and complete authorized approval
Expected_Result: Refund and reversals posted once; ledger balanced

Action: Review trial balance, student receivables and cash book
Expected_Result: Ledger debit/credit balanced; evidence attached

Action: Run payroll with earnings and deduction cases
Expected_Result: Gross - deductions = net; liabilities posted appropriately

Action: Attempt payroll approval with unauthorized role
Expected_Result: Approvals enforced; no duplicate disbursement

Action: Sign in as parent and view only linked child records
Expected_Result: No other student or payment records exposed

Action: Attempt cross-tenant access to student and finance records
Expected_Result: 403/404 and no data leakage

Action: Attempt cross-campus access with limited membership
Expected_Result: Denied for unassigned campus; audit evidence recorded

Action: Restore isolated backup and compare records and hashes

Action: Run automated Laravel/MySQL QA and review failures

Action: Check mobile navigation at 375px / 768px / desktop

Action: Validate examination publication and academic progress
Expected_Result: Approved results visible, draft results hidden

Action: Test incorrect eligibility/capacity data

Action: Verify reconciliation after correction to fee data

Action: Read notices, attendance and examination results
